components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clear next action in a workspace flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #fec51c; color: #1c1f29; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(28 31 41 / 0.05); font: 600 0.875rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f2b900; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #dda600; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1769aa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A structural alternative action that stays subordinate to yellow primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #202329; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #c8cdd5; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(28 31 41 / 0.05); font: 600 0.875rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8f9fb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1769aa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A full-width field for dependable business data entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; color: #202329; font: 600 0.875rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; color: #202329; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c8cdd5; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(28 31 41 / 0.05); font: 400 1rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #68707c; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1769aa; outline: 2px solid #1769aa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic status indicator, not a decorative label.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; color: #175033; background: #e9f7ef; border: 1px solid rgb(39 122 75 / 0.2); border-radius: 0.5rem; font: 600 0.75rem Inter, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Workspace Card
components.description: A measured container that organizes work without floating theatrics.
components.html:
Website details

Keep supporting information structured and quiet.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.25rem; color: #202329; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e1e4e9; border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(28 31 41 / 0.05); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: #626975; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: The persistent workspace orientation pattern with a clear active destination.
components.html: BusinessesWebsite

components.name: Public Site CTA
components.description: A tenant-colored action that remains crisp and readable within a public site.

narrative.overview:
BakerRang is a polished workspace for actively building, managing, and improving a business presence. It should feel capable and professional without slipping into the visual language of an internal admin console. Warmth comes from a disciplined yellow-and-charcoal identity; confidence comes from clear structure, generous working room, and controls that communicate purpose immediately.

The Portal is an Operate surface: supporting controls should make the primary work visible and easy to act on, not compete for attention. For the website builder, the live site preview is the working canvas; sidebars, toolbars, and editors are subordinate supports. Public sites share the same deliberate, credible foundation while retaining safe per-tenant theming.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, confident, and precise rather than sterile or generic.
Structured through tonal separation, borders, and low-key elevation.
Yellow is an energetic signature, used with charcoal and neutral surfaces for balance.
Clear hierarchy and purposeful interaction outweigh decoration.

rules.name: The Yellow Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the BakerRang yellow to identify a primary action, active location, or brand moment—not as a broad surface treatment.

rules.name: The Canvas-First Rule
rules.body: Keep the main working canvas, especially the live website preview, visually dominant over supporting rails and controls.

rules.name: The Work-First Type Rule
rules.body: Use weight, scale, and spacing to establish hierarchy before introducing extra color, decoration, or type styles.

rules.name: The Supporting-Rail Rule
rules.body: Navigation, inspectors, and toolbars should frame a task or canvas rather than become the visual destination themselves.

rules.name: The Structural Elevation Rule
rules.body: Elevation must explain hierarchy, focus, or temporary priority; it must not be added as decoration.

dos: Do use yellow deliberately for the primary action, active navigation, and brand recognition.
Do preserve visible borders, focus outlines, and semantic feedback states.
Do give the active working surface enough space to read and act with confidence.
Do keep tenant site themes safely scoped to their rendered sites.
donts: Don't turn the Portal into a conventional CRUD/admin console with controls competing against the work.
Don't use glassmorphism, large ambient gradients, or heavy shadows as decoration.
Don't let yellow become a default page background or substitute for semantic error/status color.
Don't make public sites look like generic AI-generated landing pages.
